test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Statements:

All developers are coders.

Some coders are gamers.

No gamer is lazy.

Conclusions:

I. Some coders are not lazy.

II. All developers may be gamers.
solution:
Least possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36316bde06762b62eb0a7adbc3554d63211fbbb2fadf7a512e5f75dbf35dc962.png] 

**Conclusions:****

I. Some coders are not lazy →** Follow** (Some coders are gamers and no gamer is lazy. so, coder which are gamers never be lazy).

II. All developers may be gamers → **Follow** (Some coders are gamers and all developers are coders. so, it is possible that all developers are gamers).

Both I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 3**”.
